text: {"name":"bt_send_current_conn_info","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Packages the current Bluetooth connection index and selected connection-context fields with a byte-swapped argument into a kernel message, performs related setup, and sends it.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"active_conn_ctx","v2":"conn_table","v3":"conn_idx","v5":"msg_payload","v6":"msg_write_cursor","v7":"conn_entry","v8":"conn_data_cursor","v9":"msg","v10":"conn_data_end","v14":"conn_entry","v15":"conn_field_368"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":61,"meaning":"Current connection index in the active connection context."},{"offset":368,"meaning":"32-bit connection-context value copied into the outgoing message."},{"offset":372,"meaning":"16-bit connection-context value copied into the outgoing message."},{"offset":374,"meaning":"Start of a 32-byte connection-context block copied into the outgoing message."},{"offset":406,"meaning":"Trailing byte copied after the 32-byte block."}]}
